  • Establish strong communication with the delivery department, acting as a bridge between brands and the platform’s delivery operations, and work collaboratively to continuously optimize the brand delivery service experience.
  • Fully leverage personal work potential, gather frontline marketing information, user feedback, and local market dynamics to provide valuable insights and references for the company's decision-making.


What We Need From You


  • Have excellent business negotiation and market development capabilities, be loyal to business goals, have insight into the needs of users, and be brave to embrace challenges.
  • Have basic data analysis skills and master office software applications. Experience in working with charts/graphs is required.
  • Integrity, honesty and resilience. Passionate about work and possessing a strong team spirit.
  • English and Portuguese can be used as working languages.


Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 94 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Executive Operator - Founder Office
description:
Executive Operator – Founder Office


São Paulo (In-person) - ✈️ Ability to travel internationally

Company: Umatch (Global AI Dating Platform – Product-led)


About the Role


We’re looking for a highly organized, fast-moving, and reliable Executive Operator to work directly with our Founder & CEO.


This is a hands-on operational role for someone who loves making things run smoothly, removing obstacles, and bringing clarity to a fast-paced environment.


You will work across operations, administration, logistics, product organization, and internal communication - ensuring the founder can focus on Product Engineering, Fundraising, Key Hires, and non-reversible decisions.


This is not a political, managerial, or strategy-only job.


This is a high-impact execution role for someone who takes pride in getting things done.


What You’ll Do


  • Organize the founder’s agenda, priorities, meetings, and travel
  • Prepare meetings with context, documents, and follow-ups
  • Coordinate internal tasks, documentation, and information flow
  • Manage operational routines (contracts, payments, suppliers, legal, finance)
  • Solve problems quickly - from simple tasks to complex issues
  • Support product & engineering with documentation and organization
  • Maintain clarity across teams and prevent misalignment
  • Handle ad hoc tasks that keep the company running smoothly
  • Act as the founder’s execution partner in all non-core areas


We’re Looking For Someone Who


  • Is extremely organized and detail-oriented
  • Learns fast and adapts even faster
  • Communicates clearly and directly
  • Loves operational work and making things run
  • Has strong English and writing skills
  • Balances autonomy with responsibility
  • Is emotionally stable, humble, and ego-free
  • Thrives in a dynamic, high-speed environment
  • Has excellent judgment and ethics
  • Can travel when needed


Must-Haves


  • Experience in operations, coordination, or project management
  • High sense of ownership
  • Strong hands-on execution
  • Digital organization mastery (Notion, Google Workspace, etc.)


What This Role Is NOT


  • ❌ Not a Chief of Staff
  • ❌ Not a managerial position
  • ❌ Not a co-founder track
  • ❌ Not a purely strategic role
  • ❌ Not for people who avoid hands-on tasks


Why This Role Matters


Our founder operates at extremely high intensity in Product Engineering, Culture, Key Hires, and Fundraising.


Your mission is to clear every obstacle so he can stay fully focused on building the next generation of global AI-driven products.


If you’re a fast, sharp, and reliable operator who loves making things work - we want to meet you.

title: Software Engineer (C#, .NET 8, Azure, GenAI)
description:
Role: Software Engineer – Investments (C#, .NET 8, Azure, GenAI))

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term

Work Hours: CST

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Location: 100% Remote (Candidates Can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


About the Role

We’re looking for a talented Software Engineer to join our Investments Technology team , helping design and build secure, scalable healthcare and identity management platforms . You’ll work across the stack using C#, .NET 8+, Azure , and Angular , while leveraging GitHub Copilot and other GenAI tools to accelerate development and innovation.

This is an exciting opportunity to work on cloud-native, event-driven systems that power secure healthcare and financial applications in a collaborative, remote-first environment.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and Build Scalable Solutions: Develop secure, high-performance applications using C#, .NET 8+, Entity Framework , and SQL .
  • Architect Modern Systems: Implement REST APIs, event-driven microservices , and integrations using Azure Service Bus and API Management (APIM) .
  • Leverage Azure Cloud: Deploy and manage applications on Azure App Service , integrate messaging, and expose APIs securely.
  • Implement Secure Authentication: Enhance identity management solutions using OAuth2 and OpenID Connect for secure access control.
  • Develop Front-End Interfaces: Build responsive UIs with Angular, TypeScript, and HTML to deliver excellent user experiences.
  • Optimize Data & APIs: Write efficient SQL queries, design APIs with OpenAPI/Swagger , and use Copilot to automate documentation.
  • Collaborate Across Teams: Partner with Product, DevOps, and QA to deliver seamless, high-quality releases within CI/CD pipelines .
  • Innovate with GenAI: Use GitHub Copilot and prompt engineering to generate code, API specs, and test scripts, boosting productivity and speed.


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience building production-grade applications with C# and .NET Core/8+ .
  • Strong understanding of REST , event-driven , and microservice architectures.
  • Experience with Azure App Service, Service Bus, and APIM .
  • Proficiency in SQL and Entity Framework for database interactions.
  • Front-end experience with Angular, TypeScript, and HTML .
  • Expertise with OpenAPI/Swagger for API documentation.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub Copilot or similar GenAI tools.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills in remote, cross-functional teams.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Azure Active Directory (AAD) or other IAM platforms.
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (HIPAA) and secure data handling.
  • Exposure to Azure Event Hubs , Kafka , or AutoGen frameworks.

title: Account Manager (Adtech)
description:
Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time


About Us

Orange Storm is a venture-backed AdTech and AI SaaS company with dual headquarters in California, USA and Barcelona, Spain. We provide an integrated ecosystem—including a DSP, SSP, Creative Studio, and AI-driven analytics platform—to help publishers and advertisers drive higher revenue and smarter decisions.

Our global, diverse team is our greatest asset. With a culture rooted in trust, ownership, and continuous learning, we empower talent to grow, experiment, and deliver real-world impact. We are proud of our collaborative spirit, agile execution, and commitment to building scalable, high-performance technologies that adapt to the ever-evolving AdTech landscape.


Role Overview:

We are seeking a high-performing Account Manager to manage and expand relationships with our advertising clients across the APAC region, including direct advertisers and agencies.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage end-to-end client relationships, ensuring successful campaign delivery, optimization, and KPI achievement.
  • Develop and implement advertising strategies to drive client ROI and campaign performance.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (operations, product, tech) to ensure smooth execution and timely issue resolution.
  • Provide clients with regular data analysis, performance reports, and actionable insights.
  • Identify upselling, cross-selling, and expansion opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Stay informed about APAC advertising market trends and competitive landscape.


Requirements:

  • 2+ years of experience in digital advertising, programmatic, or mobile marketing as an Account Manager or Customer Success Manager.
  • Fluent in English; proficiency in Mandarin is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of advertising operations, SDKs, attribution platforms like Appsflyer or Adjust, and fraud prevention.
  • Strong project management, client servicing, and communication skills.
  • Excellent analytical skills with a data-driven approach to optimization.
  • Highly self-motivated, results-oriented, and capable of managing multiple accounts remotely across time zones.


Compensation & Benefits:

  • Attractive and competitive pay and Performance Bonus + Uncapped Revenue Commission!
  • Annual Leave: 20 working days paid leave per year (pro-rated) + local public holidays
  • Remote Work: Fully remote with reasonable overlap hours; occasional travel budget if needed
  • And many more!


Orange Storm is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity at all levels of the organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to these factors.


We truly appreciate the time and effort every candidate puts into applying to Orange Storm. While we carefully review each application, due to the high volume of interest we receive, we’re unfortunately unable to respond to every individual submission. If your profile aligns with the role and we decide to move forward, a member of our team will reach out to you directly. We thank you in advance for your understanding and for considering a career with us.

title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce - Sênior (Home Office)
description:
Resumo da oportunidade:

Você fará parte de um time que cria e evolui soluções no ecossistema Salesforce, com foco em Service Cloud. O papel envolve desenvolvimento com alta qualidade e performance, integrações e desenho de dados, colaborando com equipes de projeto e interagindo com suporte global em inglês.


Responsabilidades do dia a dia:

  • Implementar funcionalidades no Salesforce (Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce/Aura) com foco em performance e qualidade.
  • Desenvolver e manter integrações com APIs (REST, SOAP, Metadata) e orquestrar processos com Flow.
  • Modelar dados e desenhar soluções aderentes ao Service Cloud.
  • Participar ativamente das definições técnicas com as equipes de projeto, propondo melhorias.
  • Versionar código com Git e colaborar em práticas ágeis do time.
  • Acompanhar novidades do Salesforce e aplicar quando fizer sentido.
  • Atuar em esquema de plantão fora do horário comercial, em rodízio com o time.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de implementação e customização no Salesforce Service Cloud.
  • Stack: Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components, LWC, Aura, batches, triggers e schedules.
  • Integrações: experiência com Salesforce APIs (REST, SOAP, Metadata).
  • Arquitetura/Dados: modelagem de dados e design de soluções Salesforce.
  • Processos: práticas ágeis e versionamento com Git.
  • Automação: Flow.
  • Canais/IA: Digital Engagement e Einstein Bots e AgentForce.
  • Idioma: inglês para conversação (comunicação com Suporte Global Salesforce).
  • Disponibilidade: plantão fora do horário comercial, em esquema de rodízio com o time.


Habilidades:

  • Escrever código Apex e LWC performáticos, seguros e reutilizáveis.
  • Projetar integrações resilientes e monitoráveis entre sistemas.
  • Estruturar modelos de dados consistentes e aderentes ao negócio.
  • Colaborar em definições técnicas e revisão de soluções com o time.
  • Organizar o trabalho em ciclos ágeis, mantendo rastreabilidade no Git.


Atitudes:

  • Comunicação clara e colaboração no trabalho em equipe.
  • Resolução de problemas com foco em impacto e qualidade.
  • Adaptabilidade a mudanças de contexto e prioridades.
  • Aprendizado contínuo e curiosidade pelas novidades da plataforma.


Condições da vaga

  • Modelo de contratação: PJ .
  • Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (Home Office) .

title: Desenvolvedor de firmware
description:
Desenvolvedor de Firmware | CLT | 100% Remota


Sobre nós e Resumo da posição

A Control iD é uma indústria brasileira, especializada no desenvolvimento de relógio de ponto, controle de acesso e equipamentos para automação comercial.

Aqui você terá a chance de criar soluções que conectam +300 mil dispositivos IoT e impactam +1 milhão de usuários ativos, em um ambiente que valoriza inovação e liberdade tecnológica.


O que buscamos:

  • Forte experiência em C++ e sistemas embutidos/embarcados;
  • Vivência com Linux ;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas embarcados ;
  • Experiência em otimização de performance, consumo e recursos de hardware;
  • Familiaridade com protocolos de comunicação (UART, SPI, I2C, TCP/IP, etc.);
  • Boas práticas de segurança e qualidade de código;
  • Atuação em metodologias ágeis.


Seu papel será:

Participar de todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento de firmware — desde a concepção, arquitetura, implementação até os testes — sempre com foco em segurança, performance e escalabilidade para produtos conectados.


Diferenciais da vaga:

  • 100% remoto;
  • VR sem desconto em folha;
  • Convênio médico com coparticipação apenas quando usar;
  • PLR + Seguro de Vida;
  • Totalpass;
  • Participação prática nos produtos desenvolvidos pela empresa.

title: Analista de Recebíveis
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Reuniões mensais com jurídico para tomada de decisão nas ações judiciais relacionadas a contrato de locação;
  • Mapeamento e cobrança de saldos com lojistas;
  • Recuperação de crédito;
  • Controles e planilhas para report da companhia;
  • Apresentações mensais de resultado relacionado a inadimplência;
  • Interface com lojistas e clientes externos.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação Superior completo em Administração, Comunicação, Economia, Engenharia de Produção, Direito ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pacote Office avançado, com foco em Excel;
  • Experiência com contas a receber será um diferencial.


O Que Temos Para Você

title: ServiceNow Administrator
description:
Bradford Jacobs has partnered with an award-winning Technology Solution Provider dedicated to protecting and empowering organizations across the central U.S. They deliver innovative, business-aligned solutions in cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, Microsoft, Salesforce, and support services.


They are expaniding and looking to add an exprienced SNOW Administrator to the team. WIthing this role you will lead the reporting, analytics, and KPI strategy for the ServiceNow platform—driving data visibility, operational performance insights, and measurable ROI.


What You’ll Do:

  • Own ServiceNow reporting and analytics governance across all modules.
  • Define and standardize KPIs, reporting cadence, and data quality frameworks.
  • Design and build dashboards and reports in Performance Analytics, Reporting, and Visualization tools.
  • Deliver executive and operational dashboards providing real-time service and performance insights.
  • Collaborate with business and platform owners to align reporting with goals and ITIL frameworks.
  • Ensure data accuracy, governance, and consistency across ServiceNow, Power BI, and Salesforce.
  • Measure and communicate platform adoption, automation gains, and productivity improvements.
  • Stay current on ServiceNow releases, AI/Now Assist features, and emerging analytics capabilities.


What You Bring:

  • 3+ years of ServiceNow experience (Performance Analytics, Reporting, or Data Visualization).
  • Proven ability to design dashboards across ITSM, CSM, and SPM modules.
  • Strong knowledge of ServiceNow data models, tables, and CMDB relationships.
  • Excellent collaboration, analytical, and presentation skills.


Preferred:

  • Experience in an MSP or multi-client environment.
  • Familiarity with ITIL KPI frameworks (MTTR, SLA, backlog, etc.).
  • Experience with VividCharts, Power BI, or Tableau.
  • Exposure to Automation Engine, Flow Designer, or Now Assist analytics.


Certifications (Preferred):

  • ServiceNow CSA, Performance Analytics & Reporting Micro-Certs, ITIL 4 Foundation.

description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. We are looking for Integrator - Solution who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


  • Experience with Apache products specifically: Geronimo, Tomcat, Camel, ServiceMix, Axis
  • Experience integrating with ESB/IBUS technologies: Fuse ESB, Tibco, Web sphere etc
  • Experience in use of Oracle and SQL
  • Experience in development of pure Java based applications and Java middleware tier business logic
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience authoring software for Windows and/or Linux.
  • Minimum 7+ years of experience authoring software C/C++, KSH and Java.
  • Experience of developing WSDLs and XSDs

Must have worked on Grid application (SCAD/ADMS/EMS/OMS applications)

  • In this position, you will occupy valued role on development and implementation of mission critical grid software/Energy Management system. You will design and develop software for interface and/or webservices to integrate different utility systems.

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!



We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.


You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.


This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.


We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.


Who are we?



BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .



What you will do:



  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.



What we expect from you:


  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.



What We Offer


  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.



Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce - Sênior (Home Office)
description:
Resumo da oportunidade:

Você fará parte de um time que cria e evolui soluções no ecossistema Salesforce, com foco em Service Cloud. O papel envolve desenvolvimento com alta qualidade e performance, integrações e desenho de dados, colaborando com equipes de projeto e interagindo com suporte global em inglês.


Responsabilidades do dia a dia:

  • Implementar funcionalidades no Salesforce (Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce/Aura) com foco em performance e qualidade.
  • Desenvolver e manter integrações com APIs (REST, SOAP, Metadata) e orquestrar processos com Flow.
  • Modelar dados e desenhar soluções aderentes ao Service Cloud.
  • Participar ativamente das definições técnicas com as equipes de projeto, propondo melhorias.
  • Versionar código com Git e colaborar em práticas ágeis do time.
  • Acompanhar novidades do Salesforce e aplicar quando fizer sentido.
  • Atuar em esquema de plantão fora do horário comercial, em rodízio com o time.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de implementação e customização no Salesforce Service Cloud.
  • Stack: Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components, LWC, Aura, batches, triggers e schedules.
  • Integrações: experiência com Salesforce APIs (REST, SOAP, Metadata).
  • Arquitetura/Dados: modelagem de dados e design de soluções Salesforce.
  • Processos: práticas ágeis e versionamento com Git.
  • Automação: Flow.
  • Canais/IA: Digital Engagement e Einstein Bots e AgentForce.
  • Idioma: inglês para conversação (comunicação com Suporte Global Salesforce).
  • Disponibilidade: plantão fora do horário comercial, em esquema de rodízio com o time.


Habilidades:

  • Escrever código Apex e LWC performáticos, seguros e reutilizáveis.
  • Projetar integrações resilientes e monitoráveis entre sistemas.
  • Estruturar modelos de dados consistentes e aderentes ao negócio.
  • Colaborar em definições técnicas e revisão de soluções com o time.
  • Organizar o trabalho em ciclos ágeis, mantendo rastreabilidade no Git.


Atitudes:

  • Comunicação clara e colaboração no trabalho em equipe.
  • Resolução de problemas com foco em impacto e qualidade.
  • Adaptabilidade a mudanças de contexto e prioridades.
  • Aprendizado contínuo e curiosidade pelas novidades da plataforma.


Condições da vaga

  • Modelo de contratação: PJ .
  • Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (Home Office) .

title: Solutions Integrator
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for Integrator - Solution who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


  • Experience with Apache products specifically: Geronimo, Tomcat, Camel, ServiceMix, Axis
  • Experience integrating with ESB/IBUS technologies: Fuse ESB, Tibco, Web sphere etc
  • Experience in use of Oracle and SQL
  • Experience in development of pure Java based applications and Java middleware tier business logic
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience authoring software for Windows and/or Linux.
  • Minimum 7+ years of experience authoring software C/C++, KSH and Java.
  • Experience of developing WSDLs and XSDs

Must have worked on Grid application (SCAD/ADMS/EMS/OMS applications)


Roles & Responsibilities

  • In this position, you will occupy valued role on development and implementation of mission critical grid software/Energy Management system. You will design and develop software for interface and/or webservices to integrate different utility systems.


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Desenvolvedor de firmware
description:
Desenvolvedor de Firmware | CLT | 100% Remota


Sobre nós e Resumo da posição

A Control iD é uma indústria brasileira, especializada no desenvolvimento de relógio de ponto, controle de acesso e equipamentos para automação comercial.

Aqui você terá a chance de criar soluções que conectam +300 mil dispositivos IoT e impactam +1 milhão de usuários ativos, em um ambiente que valoriza inovação e liberdade tecnológica.


O que buscamos:

  • Forte experiência em C++ e sistemas embutidos/embarcados;
  • Vivência com Linux ;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas embarcados ;
  • Experiência em otimização de performance, consumo e recursos de hardware;
  • Familiaridade com protocolos de comunicação (UART, SPI, I2C, TCP/IP, etc.);
  • Boas práticas de segurança e qualidade de código;
  • Atuação em metodologias ágeis.


Seu papel será:

Participar de todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento de firmware — desde a concepção, arquitetura, implementação até os testes — sempre com foco em segurança, performance e escalabilidade para produtos conectados.


Diferenciais da vaga:

  • 100% remoto;
  • VR sem desconto em folha;
  • Convênio médico com coparticipação apenas quando usar;
  • PLR + Seguro de Vida;
  • Totalpass;
  • Participação prática nos produtos desenvolvidos pela empresa.

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!



We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.


You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.


This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.


We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.


Who are we?



BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .



What you will do:



  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.



What we expect from you:


  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.



What We Offer


  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.



Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

title: ServiceNow Administrator
description:
Bradford Jacobs has partnered with an award-winning Technology Solution Provider dedicated to protecting and empowering organizations across the central U.S. They deliver innovative, business-aligned solutions in cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, Microsoft, Salesforce, and support services.


They are expaniding and looking to add an exprienced SNOW Administrator to the team. WIthing this role you will lead the reporting, analytics, and KPI strategy for the ServiceNow platform—driving data visibility, operational performance insights, and measurable ROI.


What You’ll Do:

  • Own ServiceNow reporting and analytics governance across all modules.
  • Define and standardize KPIs, reporting cadence, and data quality frameworks.
  • Design and build dashboards and reports in Performance Analytics, Reporting, and Visualization tools.
  • Deliver executive and operational dashboards providing real-time service and performance insights.
  • Collaborate with business and platform owners to align reporting with goals and ITIL frameworks.
  • Ensure data accuracy, governance, and consistency across ServiceNow, Power BI, and Salesforce.
  • Measure and communicate platform adoption, automation gains, and productivity improvements.
  • Stay current on ServiceNow releases, AI/Now Assist features, and emerging analytics capabilities.


What You Bring:

  • 3+ years of ServiceNow experience (Performance Analytics, Reporting, or Data Visualization).
  • Proven ability to design dashboards across ITSM, CSM, and SPM modules.
  • Strong knowledge of ServiceNow data models, tables, and CMDB relationships.
  • Excellent collaboration, analytical, and presentation skills.


Preferred:

  • Experience in an MSP or multi-client environment.
  • Familiarity with ITIL KPI frameworks (MTTR, SLA, backlog, etc.).
  • Experience with VividCharts, Power BI, or Tableau.
  • Exposure to Automation Engine, Flow Designer, or Now Assist analytics.


Certifications (Preferred):

  • ServiceNow CSA, Performance Analytics & Reporting Micro-Certs, ITIL 4 Foundation.

title: (Contract) Psychotherapist / Psychologist
description:
Part-Time Mental Health Therapist (Hybrid: Remote & In-Person)


Location: Marau, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil


Our mission: to eliminate every barrier to mental health.


Spring Health is the leading comprehensive mental health benefit for employers. We help employees understand their mental health issues and connect with best-in-class providers to get the right treatment at the right time.

From early detection to full recovery, Spring Health is the only clinically validated solution in the market proven to be more effective than traditional mental healthcare. By combining the latest technology with vetted providers, we help engage 1 in 3 employees, reduce recovery times, and lower healthcare costs. We are an award-winning, passionate, and mission-driven team with the support of leaders in psychiatry.

We are seeking qualified, part-time internationally licensed psychotherapists to join our provider network and deliver care with a tech-enabled, AI/machine-learning platform that puts patient outcomes first.


What You'll Do

  • Provide counseling to clients with benefits ranging from short-term goal-focused EAP, to employer health plans allowing as many sessions as medically necessary.
  • Treat adults who have completed brief, evidence-based online screenings identifying their symptoms and areas of concern.
  • Preferably, also be open to treating additional populations such as children, adolescents, couples, or families.
  • Maintain a calendar displaying your availability and complete session documentation in a timely manner within our scheduling system.
  • Use evidence-based treatment modalities and interventions that are tailored to your client’s needs.
  • Collaborate with our dedicated provider support team, our licensed clinical care navigation team, and our administrative care support team whenever you need assistance.
  • Provide culturally competent and empathetic care, upholding our values of diversity and inclusion for all races, ethnicities, and genders.



Who you are

  • You are properly qualified (licensed, if applicable) to practice counseling (as a Psychologist, Psychotherapist, Clinical Psychologist, etc.) in Brazil. We are not able to accept applications from anyone requiring clinical supervision.
  • You maintain active professional liability insurance at market rates in your approved jurisdiction (country of licensure).
  • You have a minimum of 3 years of independent clinical experience.
  • You have access to a computer or laptop, are comfortable with technology, and are tele-health competent.
  • You are available to offer some amount of monthly in-person availability for Spring Health members in Marau.
  • You have training and experience in evidence-based modalities of care such as CBT, DBT, EMDR, ACT, CPT.
  • You are comfortable with providing safety planning and intervention during situations where a client might present with higher risks.
  • You are committed to quality clinical care and want to expand your capabilities and increase your effectiveness by being informed of client progress or challenges.
  • You like working independently, but would also enjoy having the support of a team and opportunities for connections and collaboration with other providers and our master’s level clinical care navigators.


If you are applying to a hybrid role, please be aware that your own office space will be required.


Why you'll like working with Spring Health

  • You’ll set your own schedule to fit your professional and personal needs.
  • Work from anywhere, as long as you have a confidential, private location with stable internet.
  • No need to spend time marketing your practice, checking insurance eligibility, collecting fees, or submitting claims---we take care of the administrative work so that you can focus on clinical care.
  • Grow your ability to provide effective care through feedback from evidence-based measures that help you identify what is working with your clients.
  • Join a dynamic community where you will be supported, your work appreciated, and you’ll have the opportunity to help us shape the future of mental health care!


In addition to finding people who are truly excellent at what they do, we take our values at Spring Health seriously:


Members Come First We are genuine member advocates.

Move Fast to Change Lives We build with urgency and intention.

Take Ownership We extend trust and hold ourselves accountable.

Embrace Diverse Teams & Perspectives We find strength in the diversity of cultural backgrounds, ideas, and experiences.

Science Will Win We will achieve impact by innovation and evidence based frameworks.

Candor with Care We are open, honest and empathetic.


Spring Health is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable legal requirements. Spring Health is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce - Sênior (Home Office)
description:
Resumo da oportunidade:

Você fará parte de um time que cria e evolui soluções no ecossistema Salesforce, com foco em Service Cloud. O papel envolve desenvolvimento com alta qualidade e performance, integrações e desenho de dados, colaborando com equipes de projeto e interagindo com suporte global em inglês.


Responsabilidades do dia a dia:

  • Implementar funcionalidades no Salesforce (Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce/Aura) com foco em performance e qualidade.
  • Desenvolver e manter integrações com APIs (REST, SOAP, Metadata) e orquestrar processos com Flow.
  • Modelar dados e desenhar soluções aderentes ao Service Cloud.
  • Participar ativamente das definições técnicas com as equipes de projeto, propondo melhorias.
  • Versionar código com Git e colaborar em práticas ágeis do time.
  • Acompanhar novidades do Salesforce e aplicar quando fizer sentido.
  • Atuar em esquema de plantão fora do horário comercial, em rodízio com o time.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de implementação e customização no Salesforce Service Cloud.
  • Stack: Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components, LWC, Aura, batches, triggers e schedules.
  • Integrações: experiência com Salesforce APIs (REST, SOAP, Metadata).
  • Arquitetura/Dados: modelagem de dados e design de soluções Salesforce.
  • Processos: práticas ágeis e versionamento com Git.
  • Automação: Flow.
  • Canais/IA: Digital Engagement e Einstein Bots e AgentForce.
  • Idioma: inglês para conversação (comunicação com Suporte Global Salesforce).
  • Disponibilidade: plantão fora do horário comercial, em esquema de rodízio com o time.


Habilidades:

  • Escrever código Apex e LWC performáticos, seguros e reutilizáveis.
  • Projetar integrações resilientes e monitoráveis entre sistemas.
  • Estruturar modelos de dados consistentes e aderentes ao negócio.
  • Colaborar em definições técnicas e revisão de soluções com o time.
  • Organizar o trabalho em ciclos ágeis, mantendo rastreabilidade no Git.


Atitudes:

  • Comunicação clara e colaboração no trabalho em equipe.
  • Resolução de problemas com foco em impacto e qualidade.
  • Adaptabilidade a mudanças de contexto e prioridades.
  • Aprendizado contínuo e curiosidade pelas novidades da plataforma.


Condições da vaga

  • Modelo de contratação: PJ .
  • Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (Home Office) .

title: Solutions Integrator
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for Integrator - Solution who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


  • Experience with Apache products specifically: Geronimo, Tomcat, Camel, ServiceMix, Axis
  • Experience integrating with ESB/IBUS technologies: Fuse ESB, Tibco, Web sphere etc
  • Experience in use of Oracle and SQL
  • Experience in development of pure Java based applications and Java middleware tier business logic
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience authoring software for Windows and/or Linux.
  • Minimum 7+ years of experience authoring software C/C++, KSH and Java.
  • Experience of developing WSDLs and XSDs

Must have worked on Grid application (SCAD/ADMS/EMS/OMS applications)


Roles & Responsibilities

  • In this position, you will occupy valued role on development and implementation of mission critical grid software/Energy Management system. You will design and develop software for interface and/or webservices to integrate different utility systems.


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Desenvolvedor de firmware
description:
Desenvolvedor de Firmware | CLT | 100% Remota


Sobre nós e Resumo da posição

A Control iD é uma indústria brasileira, especializada no desenvolvimento de relógio de ponto, controle de acesso e equipamentos para automação comercial.

Aqui você terá a chance de criar soluções que conectam +300 mil dispositivos IoT e impactam +1 milhão de usuários ativos, em um ambiente que valoriza inovação e liberdade tecnológica.


O que buscamos:

  • Forte experiência em C++ e sistemas embutidos/embarcados;
  • Vivência com Linux ;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas embarcados ;
  • Experiência em otimização de performance, consumo e recursos de hardware;
  • Familiaridade com protocolos de comunicação (UART, SPI, I2C, TCP/IP, etc.);
  • Boas práticas de segurança e qualidade de código;
  • Atuação em metodologias ágeis.


Seu papel será:

Participar de todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento de firmware — desde a concepção, arquitetura, implementação até os testes — sempre com foco em segurança, performance e escalabilidade para produtos conectados.


Diferenciais da vaga:

  • 100% remoto;
  • VR sem desconto em folha;
  • Convênio médico com coparticipação apenas quando usar;
  • PLR + Seguro de Vida;
  • Totalpass;
  • Participação prática nos produtos desenvolvidos pela empresa.

title: ServiceNow Administrator
description:
Bradford Jacobs has partnered with an award-winning Technology Solution Provider dedicated to protecting and empowering organizations across the central U.S. They deliver innovative, business-aligned solutions in cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, Microsoft, Salesforce, and support services.


They are expaniding and looking to add an exprienced SNOW Administrator to the team. WIthing this role you will lead the reporting, analytics, and KPI strategy for the ServiceNow platform—driving data visibility, operational performance insights, and measurable ROI.


What You’ll Do:

  • Own ServiceNow reporting and analytics governance across all modules.
  • Define and standardize KPIs, reporting cadence, and data quality frameworks.
  • Design and build dashboards and reports in Performance Analytics, Reporting, and Visualization tools.
  • Deliver executive and operational dashboards providing real-time service and performance insights.
  • Collaborate with business and platform owners to align reporting with goals and ITIL frameworks.
  • Ensure data accuracy, governance, and consistency across ServiceNow, Power BI, and Salesforce.
  • Measure and communicate platform adoption, automation gains, and productivity improvements.
  • Stay current on ServiceNow releases, AI/Now Assist features, and emerging analytics capabilities.


What You Bring:

  • 3+ years of ServiceNow experience (Performance Analytics, Reporting, or Data Visualization).
  • Proven ability to design dashboards across ITSM, CSM, and SPM modules.
  • Strong knowledge of ServiceNow data models, tables, and CMDB relationships.
  • Excellent collaboration, analytical, and presentation skills.


Preferred:

  • Experience in an MSP or multi-client environment.
  • Familiarity with ITIL KPI frameworks (MTTR, SLA, backlog, etc.).
  • Experience with VividCharts, Power BI, or Tableau.
  • Exposure to Automation Engine, Flow Designer, or Now Assist analytics.


Certifications (Preferred):

  • ServiceNow CSA, Performance Analytics & Reporting Micro-Certs, ITIL 4 Foundation.

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!



We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.


You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.


This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.


We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.


Who are we?



BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .



What you will do:



  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.



What we expect from you:


  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.



What We Offer


  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.



Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

title: Arquiteto Devops
description:
E qual será a sua missão na Framework?

A sua missão será desenhar, evoluir e garantir a integridade técnica das arquiteturas em nuvem que sustentam nossos produtos digitais , aplicando práticas modernas de DevOps, automação, segurança e observabilidade em Google Cloud Platform (GCP) .

Você será responsável por estruturar e documentar arquiteturas de referência , traduzindo requisitos técnicos e de negócio em diagramas claros e escaláveis , além de implementar pipelines, automações e padrões que garantam performance, segurança e governança dos ambientes.

Mais do que construir soluções, esperamos que você atue como referência técnica e disseminador da cultura DevOps , apoiando squads e stakeholders na tomada de decisão arquitetural e na evolução contínua dos ecossistemas em nuvem da Framework e de seus clientes.


O que é preciso para fazer parte do time?

  • Experiência sólida como Arquiteto DevOps ou Engenheiro Cloud com foco em Google Cloud Platform (GCP) .
  • Domínio de CI/CD (Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, Jenkins ou GitLab CI) .
  • Prática em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Ansible, Cloud Deployment Manager ou similares) .
  • Vivência com monitoramento, observabilidade e logging (Stackdriver, Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic).
  • Experiência em containerização e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes, GKE).
  • Conhecimento em segurança de pipelines, políticas IAM e gestão de secrets .
  • Entendimento de arquiteturas distribuídas, escalabilidade e resiliência de sistemas .

Será um diferencial se você:

  • Tiver experiência com ambientes híbridos (GCP + on-premises ou multicloud) .
  • Dominar práticas de FinOps e otimização de custos em nuvem .
  • Já tiver atuado em consultorias ou empresas de tecnologia com alto volume transacional .
  • Possuir conhecimento adicional em Azure ou AWS , ou ferramentas de observabilidade avançada (Datadog, New Relic, Dynatrace) .
  • Demonstrar pensamento sistêmico e visão estratégica , contribuindo com decisões de arquitetura e escalabilidade.
  • Certificações complementares em DevOps, SRE, Kubernetes ou Security.

title: SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS)
description:
You’re purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. That’s the spirit of the community you’ll find at Orbia: where the purpose to advance life around the world drives our global team of over 23,000 every single day.

From creating solutions to deliver clean water, secure food supplies and reliable information to steering material advances that power the future of green and smart cities, transportation, and healthcare, we never settle for “good enough” when there’s an opportunity to make life better. Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we live for.


Fluor & Energy Materials , an Orbia business, is looking for a SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS) to be based at México, Colombia or Brazil !


Job Summary/ Purpose

Our team, the Service Delivery Management for Global Applications, is responsible to ensure operational continuity of Orbia’s Global Business Applications like SAP ECC, S/4, CFIN, SuccessFactors and others. The support of these applications is under a Managed Service partner, and our role is to supervise and ensure that this service is delivered to Orbia’s standards of quality and following our processes and policies. This role will have a specific responsibility over initiatives that require Developments in those applications, by supporting and monitoring the service of the AMS (Application Managed Support) partners, defining and enforcing best practices and security standards, and providing operational support when needed (e.g. in case of escalations, issues with in-house developed apps or legacy apps).


Main Responsibilities

  • Creation of best practices and operational processes related to Application Development in SAP ECC and S/4 (ABAP, BTP, Fiori).
  • On a general note and not restricted to Development initiatives: Being a point of contact for Orbia’s companies located in LATAM, guiding them through our Service Delivery Model when needed and ensuring that they get the right support on time.
  • Provide operational support (in collaboration with the AMS partner) to application/integrations developed in-house or other developments in Legacy Applications when needed. Provide ideas to the Application Solution leads for those Legacy apps/integrations to be included the target architecture roadmap. Support their transition to target architecture when needed (e.g. from a local application to S/4 BTP portals or apps).
  • Ensure that developments or customizations in the S/4 applications are done following the Digital Decoupling strategy as defined by the Orbia Global Applications team.
  • Support and drive automation initiatives where possible, with a final goal of incident reduction and self-service (e.g. self-healing, monitoring and alert systems, automation of standard requests, etc.).
  • Drive and encourage new ways of working in collaboration with the AMS partner, for example Devops or Scrum.
  • Participation in the major incident process when needed, for Americas’ applications/time zones.
  • Participation in CAB or coordination with IT Service Desk meetings when needed.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish.


Knowledge/ Experience Required

  • Good understanding of SAP ECC and S/4 Technical and Development functionalities (BTP, Basis, ABAP, Fiori/JAVA, etc.).
  • Good knowledge of ITIL framework.
  • Ability to take on the above-mentioned responsibilities with a constructive and collaborative approach.
  • Passion for Service standardization and improvement.
  • Excellent people skills, ability to manage escalations from business colleagues from all levels of the organization.
  • Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines when needed.
  • Able to manage and prioritize tasks and time efficiently, and coordinate efforts with external partners in an effective manner.
  • Able to demonstrate initiative and a proactive approach to daily tasks.


Behaviors that can help you succeed at Orbia:

  • Develop yourself & Others
  • Foster Collaboration & Inclusion
  • Drive Results
  • Provide Vision & Direction


We welcome purpose-driven dreamers, doers, and builders, recognizing that it takes difference to make a difference. If you’re ready to bring your skills, talents, and perspective to moving your career, the company, people, and the planet forward, we’d like to hear from you.

We believe that every voice matters; every community deserves respect; and every challenge is an opportunity and united by empathy, we are stronger for our different perspectives. We are dedicated to building a more diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace that supports the needs of all our employees regardless of their role, location, identity, and background.

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: ServiceNow Administrator
description:
Bradford Jacobs has partnered with an award-winning Technology Solution Provider dedicated to protecting and empowering organizations across the central U.S. They deliver innovative, business-aligned solutions in cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, Microsoft, Salesforce, and support services.


They are expaniding and looking to add an exprienced SNOW Administrator to the team. WIthing this role you will lead the reporting, analytics, and KPI strategy for the ServiceNow platform—driving data visibility, operational performance insights, and measurable ROI.


What You’ll Do:

  • Own ServiceNow reporting and analytics governance across all modules.
  • Define and standardize KPIs, reporting cadence, and data quality frameworks.
  • Design and build dashboards and reports in Performance Analytics, Reporting, and Visualization tools.
  • Deliver executive and operational dashboards providing real-time service and performance insights.
  • Collaborate with business and platform owners to align reporting with goals and ITIL frameworks.
  • Ensure data accuracy, governance, and consistency across ServiceNow, Power BI, and Salesforce.
  • Measure and communicate platform adoption, automation gains, and productivity improvements.
  • Stay current on ServiceNow releases, AI/Now Assist features, and emerging analytics capabilities.


What You Bring:

  • 3+ years of ServiceNow experience (Performance Analytics, Reporting, or Data Visualization).
  • Proven ability to design dashboards across ITSM, CSM, and SPM modules.
  • Strong knowledge of ServiceNow data models, tables, and CMDB relationships.
  • Excellent collaboration, analytical, and presentation skills.


Preferred:

  • Experience in an MSP or multi-client environment.
  • Familiarity with ITIL KPI frameworks (MTTR, SLA, backlog, etc.).
  • Experience with VividCharts, Power BI, or Tableau.
  • Exposure to Automation Engine, Flow Designer, or Now Assist analytics.


Certifications (Preferred):

  • ServiceNow CSA, Performance Analytics & Reporting Micro-Certs, ITIL 4 Foundation.

title: Casting Coordinator
description:
As Blueclip, we started our journey to bring the most creative minds and the know-how together to deliver great works.


About Our Search

We are currently looking for a Casting Coordinator to join our client, a global content company with a focus on talent sourcing for dynamic content projects.


What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in casting, story production, or talent interviewing.
  • Strong communication skills in English.
  • Proficiency with various casting resources and familiarity with social media platforms like TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Twitch.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to work efficiently under tight deadlines.
  • Organized, self-motivated, and capable of handling multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Positive attitude with flexibility to adapt to last-minute changes and cancellations.
  • Experience with casting databases and familiarity with Monday.com and Google Suite.


What will you do?

This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to talent sourcing and casting across innovative content projects.


  • Identify and source emerging talent across social media platforms, staying on top of trends.
  • Post-casting calls aligned with creative outlines for new and ongoing productions.
  • Screen, organize, and categorize auditions, preparing submissions for producer review.
  • Coordinate auditions with talent, agencies, and managers, managing the talent booking process.
  • Maintain a robust casting database with accurate records and updated talent profiles.
  • Collaborate with Performance Managers to validate profiles, negotiate terms, and align schedules.
  • Produce and direct assigned content episodes, ensuring alignment with strategy, budget, and creative goals.
  • Hosting the episodes on Youtube, being on camera as an interviewer.
  • Build strong relationships with the talent to foster positive creative collaborations and ensure smooth productions.
  • Track deadlines, legal requirements, and production specifications for timely and cost-effective delivery.


Are you ready to make an impact in content creation? Apply now with your English CV !

title: Desenvolvedor Pleno
description:
Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


O que buscamos:

O Desenvolvedor Pleno é um profissional multi-skill, com olhar para o design digital e com experiência nos elementos de experiência do usuário e acessibilidade. O foco principal do trabalho será em projetos de baixa complexidade, atuando com desenvolvimento de aplicações IVA, no Veeva, programação de banners animados HTML/CSS, com o GWD e e-mails marketing , mas também incluirá edição de conteúdo de websites, uso de webapps de terceiros e estruturas de programas para o iPad. Espera-se que você forneça suporte às equipes de desenvolvimento sênior na codificação, atualize o código existente com pedidos de mudança de conteúdo e auxilie na depuração de problemas logados pelo time de QA. Haverá o uso diário de ferramentas como Figma, Adobe XD e Photoshop (assim como de outros programas do Adobe Creative Suite). Você deverá estar familiarizado com estes programas e se sentir confortável em usá-los para visualizar layouts e exportar imagens.


Responsabilidades:

• Domínio da plataforma Veeva para o desenvolvimento e manutenção em IVAs.

• Programação de banners e emails (formatos iniciais e ajustes de materiais já existentes);

• Elaboração de screenshots (para os quais terá um treinamento por parte da empresa);

• Entendimento dos pedidos e instruções em inglês nos documentos marcados e implementar as mudanças solicitadas;

• Participar de scrums internos e/ou planejamento de projetos;

• Traduzir projetos criativos para um código limpo e livre de erros que se alinhe às melhores práticas do Studio Rx;

• Assegurar que os pedidos de trabalho sejam concluídos com qualidade e no tempo estabelecido;

• Obter e manter as certificações exigidas, conforme identificadas pela equipe de Operações.


Requerimentos & Skills:

• Bacharelado em Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas;

• 4-6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento com proficiência em desenvolvimento web de front-end (padrões web HTML5);

• Certificação Veeva para desenvolvimento de IVAs;

• Experiência com animações CSS, transições e uso de key frame;

• Experiência com estruturas Javascript ou JS (Jquery, Angular, Node);

• Experiência com Git, Azure, SVN, ou sistemas de controle de versões similares;

• Uso do Adobe Creative Suite (Figma, XD e Photoshop);

• Familiaridade com HTML 5 e Web Standards, SEO, Acessibilidade, desenvolvimento de e-mails visando à compatibilidade cross-browser/cross-platform, javascript e algum framework (React, Angular, Vue, Next);

• Uso de ferramentas para emular dispositivos móveis e sistemas operacionais (BrowserStack, E-mail on Acid);

• Familiarizado com dispositivos tablet (Android, iPad) e smartphones;

• Inglês Avançado (foco em leitura, interpretação de texto e escrita).


Informações Adicionais:

Modelo de contratação: CLT

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Horário de trabalho: Das 10h00 ás 19h00

  • Proficiência em Java e/ou Angular;
  • Experiência com Kafka ;
  • Conhecimentos desejáveis em Apache Flink , OPC-UA e MQTT;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban etc.);
  • Bom nível de idioma inglês e/ou alemão .

title: SAP Project Manager
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role:

We are looking for a Senior SAP Project Manager to join a global manufacturing company for a key implementation in Brazil and Latam.

The ideal candidate will have experience in SAP SD-LE and MM , logistics processes (3PL) , and EDI .


Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead project milestones, manage risks, and ensure deliverables are met
  • Coordinate with business and IT stakeholders across regional and global teams
  • Track project progress, manage issues, and compile status reports
  • Support SIT/UAT testing, cut-over planning, hyper care, and change requests (CRs)

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in SAP Project Management
  • Strong technical background in SAP SD-LE and MM
  • Exposure to 3PL and EDI processes
  • Advanced English and intermediate Spanish
  • Strong communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills


UST is waiting for you!!
